notes.title: One year since the release!
notes.notes:
It's been a year since I released Running in the Y2K.

In numbers, this game is probably the worst I have ever published, BUT, It helped me a lot.

It helped me improve my skills making games, planning, missing deadlines...

It is a step in my journey that has made my other games possible, and for that it has a special place in my heart.

I want to thank everyone who has played the game, everyone who is still playing from time to time. Everyone that made it so hard to climb the leaderboards, I had to practice to beat you guys at my own game!

I guess that's it, just a big Thanks for playing this game!
